verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships an official desktop app that community users praise, and a hosted or self-hosted multi-user web workspace. Both surfaces advertise features beyond chat, including RAG, agents and meeting transcription. However, nothing documents a mobile app or confirms feature parity between the desktop and web surfaces. Missing for 10: an official mobile app, documented cross-surface feature parity, and independent corroboration of the web workspace experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics

citations.quote: Download AnythingLLM and get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.
Give your whole team a private, multi-user AI workspace — hosted by us or self-hosted on your infrastructure.
RAG, agents, and work right out of the box
I had a much smoother experience with the desktop version of AnythingLLM.
